```{r, include=FALSE}
### Read in data:
d0 <- read.csv('./FINLAND_12.csv')
### Extract needed columns:
d <- d0[, c("CR40", "OR15", "OR16", "CR2")]
### Preprocess variables:
### Sex:
d$sex <- factor(d$CR2, levels = 1:2, labels = c('male', 'female'))
d$CR2 <- NULL
### Smoking intention:
d$intention2smoke <- factor(d$CR40, levels = 1:4, labels = c('no', 'no', 'yes', 'yes'))
d$CR40 <- NULL
### Parents smoke:
d$father_smoke <- factor(d$OR15, levels = c(1,2,3,4), labels = c('no', 'yes', 'yes', 'no'))
d$OR15 <- NULL
d$mother_smoke <- factor(d$OR16, levels = c(1,2,3,4), labels = c('no', 'yes', 'yes', 'no'))
d$OR16 <- NULL
### Any of the two:
d$parents_smoke <- NA
inds <- d$father_smoke=='yes' | d$mother_smoke=='yes'
d$parents_smoke[inds] <- 'yes'
d$parents_smoke[!inds] <- 'no'
d$parents_smoke <- factor(d$parents_smoke)
```





# Introduction

In this report, we will analyze data from the Global Youth Tobacco Survey which has been used extensively to investigate different aspects of smoking behavior in youths [see for example @sun2022prevalence]. In this report we focus on the data from Finland which contains `r nrow(d)` observations about the intention of youths to smoke in the upcoming 12 months. The data contains records of `r table(d$sex)['male']` male and `r table(d$sex)['female']` female youths.

Detailed information about the questionnaire's variables can be found [here](https://extranet.who.int/ncdsmicrodata/index.php/catalog/532/data-dictionary/F1?file_name=FINLAND_12). We are interested in examining whether the presence of smoking parents is related to the intention of smoking in the upcoming twelve months.


# Relationship between smoking parents and intention to smoke

## Statistical analysis

To investigate the relationship between the presence of smoking parents and the intention to smoke in the upcoming 12 months, a Chi-squared test was conducted. Table \@ref(tab:twobytwo) presents the corresponding 2x2 table.

```{r twobytwo}
### Frequency table:
tbl <- table('Intention to smoke'=d$intention2smoke, 'Parents smoke'=d$parents_smoke)
### Make names nicer:
nms <- names(dimnames(tbl))   # Get names
rownames(tbl) <- paste(nms[1], rownames(tbl), sep = ': ')
colnames(tbl) <- paste(nms[2], colnames(tbl), sep = ': ')
### Print table:
kable(tbl, caption = "Frequency table of the two investigated variables.")
```

```{r}
### Run chi square test:
chi <- chisq.test(tbl)
### Create table:
### Show p-value only if not too small:
p <- ifelse(chi$p.value < 0.001, yes = '< 0.001', no = round(chi$p.value, 2))
chitbl <- data.frame('Value'=round(chi$statistic, 1), 'df'=chi$parameter, 'p-value'=p)
```


The result of the Chi-squared test revealed a significant association between the two variables (see Table \@ref(tab:chitbl)).

```{r chitbl}
kable(chitbl, caption = "Test statistic and p-value of the Chi-squared test.")
```

## Data visualization

Figure \@ref(fig:brplot) visualizes the relationship between smoking parents and the intention to smoke in a grouped barplot. Alternatively, Figure \@ref(fig:pieplot) presents the same information as pie charts.

```{r mkplots, include=FALSE}
### Create figures:
### Barplot:
jpeg(filename = './barplot.jpeg', width = 15, height = 10, 
     units = 'cm', pointsize = 10, res = 300)
cls <- c('darkgrey', 'red')
barplot(tbl, beside = TRUE, col=cls, xlab='Intention to smoke', ylab='Number of cases')
legend('topright', legend = levels(d$parents_smoke), title = 'Parents smoke:', col = cls, pch=15)
dev.off()
### Pie chart:
jpeg(filename = './pieplots.jpeg', width = 15, height = 10, units = 'cm', pointsize = 10, res = 300)
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
pie(table(d$intention2smoke[d$parents_smoke=='no']), main = 'Intention to smoke\n(no smoking parents)')
pie(table(d$intention2smoke[d$parents_smoke=='yes']), main = 'Intention to smoke\n(with smoking parents)')
dev.off()
```



```{r brplot, out.width = "100%", fig.cap="Grouped barplot showing the relationship between the presence of smoking parents and the intention to smoke.", echo=FALSE}
### Barplot:
include_graphics(path = "./barplot.jpeg")
```



```{r pieplot, out.width = "100%", fig.cap="Pie charts showing the relationship between the presence of smoking parents and the intention to smoke.", echo=FALSE}
### Pieplots:
include_graphics(path = "./pieplots.jpeg")
```
